tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, so there is no exception that skips verification in development. This is consistent with the separately recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It states the current decision: TLS certificate verification stays on for all builds, development builds included, with no exception that skips it in development. It also notes that this fits the separate rule of HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.

The decision comes from Muninn records #27 and #30. Record #27 withdrew the earlier skip-verification-in-dev decision (#25), so the file doesn't mention that older option.
